title: upgrade-impact comparison, access class (v18): a vendor upgrade that would orphan, re-enable or collide with a customer's access choice is refused until an administrator confirms, and raised at boot
body:
Filing gate **③**: a task the maintainer directed. Decision objectstack-ai/objectstack#24443 was ruled **A, with the access class in v18** (ruling of record 6259332195; the maintainer's 「其他同意」 on the line 「推荐:A,访问类进 v18,其余 v18 后」).
- **Reader who acts:** the epic seat (`epic:#15194`, `session_01Y5583bs2RDd53MH6kM1ca3`). It dispatches the stages below to cloud devs, access first, measured first.
- **Dedupe:** objectstack-ai/objectstack#24443's search found no carrier among the 105 open issues. This card and its post-v18 sibling (linked below) are the carriers.

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#24421 (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24428 adds the `sharing_rule` activation type that U1 reads)

## What the ruling binds (verbatim, items 1–2, 4–5 of 6259332195)
> 1. **The comparison.** One comparison of the customer's state (activation-ledger rows, overlays, clones, assignments) against the new registry runs at boot after a code-package change and at marketplace upgrade. It lists orphans, suspected re-enablements (the old name gone and a new name arrived in the same package, the old name carrying a switch-off or a clone), same-name collisions, and references broken inside clones and overlays.
> 2. **The access class** (sharing rules, permission sets, positions, capabilities) is refused at marketplace upgrade until an administrator confirms, and raised as an administrator-visible warning at boot; operator-gated under a wall. Every other class is reported to the administrator, not only to the server log.
> 4. **Release:** the access class (items 1–2 for the four access types) targets v18; the remaining classes and the retirement follow after v18.
> 5. **Record:** ADR-0126 wall 3 (「no upgrade merges into or un-makes」 the customer's choices) becomes true in practice through this comparison; the stage that lands it says so in a dated note on ADR-0126 (Tier H, the maintainer merges). No rename spelling is added to the spec.

## Measured starting points (`origin/main` `e22defb13c`; the seat's read-only measurement behind objectstack-ai/objectstack#24443)
- **Keys are bare names.**
  - The activation ledger is unique on `(metadata_type, name)` (`packages/platform-objects/src/system/sys-metadata-activation.object.ts:189`). It is read for positions and permission sets in `packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts:945`, `:986-1006`. `package_id` is stored but never compared.
  - Sharing rules get a ledger type under ruling A on objectstack-ai/objectstack#24378 (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24428).
- **Existing fragments to reuse:**
  - `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/catalog-reference-report.ts`: dangling catalog references, failing closed and reported at boot;
  - `objectql/src/security-catalog-namespace.ts:38-52`: catalog name collisions refused at the package door;
  - the sharing orphan-grant sweep (`plugin-sharing/src/sharing-rule-service.ts`, `sweepOrphanedRuleGrants`).
- **The marketplace upgrade** is a re-install over an existing ledger entry (`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts:2577`, answer at `:1698`). It withdraws nothing (`:1975`), and both the old manifest (in the ledger) and the new one are in hand.
- **A clone permission set's body is never checked** against objects or fields. Unlisted fields are visible (`plugin-security/src/explain-engine.ts:886`).
- **Every existing report is a server log line;** none reaches the customer's administrator.

## Stages (the seat cuts them; each measured first; each under 3,000 lines)
- **U1: the comparison core, plus the boot report for the access class.**
  - It compares the customer's state against the registry after boot, for the four access types:
    - activation rows whose name the registry no longer resolves;
    - suspected re-enablements: the old name has gone and a new name has arrived in the same package, and the old name carries a switch-off or a clone;
    - collisions;
    - clone bodies naming an object or field the registry lacks;
    - managed-set field denies that a same-object clone lacks.
  - It raises an **administrator-visible** warning. Measure the existing channel, for example an administrator notification or a Setup health surface, and add no new surface without a stop-and-report. Under a wall, it is operator-gated.
  - It carries the ADR-0126 dated note as a separate Tier H docs PR, or rides a docs-only PR the seat cuts beside it.
- **U2: the marketplace refusal.**
  - Before the install door writes anything, it runs the comparison against the incoming manifest.
  - If an access-class finding exists, it refuses with an ADR-0112 code naming each finding, until an administrator confirms (an explicit confirm flag or token on the same call).
  - Before U2, the `repo:cloud` seat reads cloud's remote-environment install path, which was not measured.
- **Order and serial constraints.**
  - U1 runs after PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#24428, which adds the sharing-rule ledger type.
  - U1 and U2 meet C8 on `resolve-authz-context.ts` (8c-2) and `sharing-rule-service.ts` (8c-3). The seat serializes them by file, and never builds ahead of an unmerged predecessor.

## Acceptance
- **A permission set the customer switched off.** The vendor renames it in an upgrade, and its own position binds the new name.
  - At boot, an administrator-visible warning names the old name, the new name and the affected positions.
  - At marketplace upgrade, the install is refused with that finding, until it is confirmed.
- **A sharing rule the customer switched off (ledger) or cloned.** The vendor renames it. The same two outcomes apply.
- **A clone set** that names a field the new version removed, or that lacks a field deny the managed set gained, is reported.
- **No finding:** the upgrade proceeds unchanged.
- **Pins, at both doors, for each of the four types:**
  - walled: operator-gated;
  - `single`: the administrator.

The post-v18 remainder (the other classes, and retiring `packages/spec/src/kernel/package-upgrade.zod.ts`) is a separate card.
